title: NuGet repository settings
description: The nuget member of a repository document. A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable.

deleteMode.title: Delete mode
deleteMode.description: What dotnet nuget delete and nuget delete do in this repository: Unlist hides the version from search and keeps it downloadable, Delete for good removes it. A delete in trove's own pages or API always removes the version.

forwardSearch.title: Forward search
forwardSearch.description: Pass searches on to the upstream, so that clients also find packages nobody has fetched through trove yet. Turn it off to search only what this repository has cached and to keep search terms inside your network.

vulnerabilityInfo.title: Vulnerability information
vulnerabilityInfo.description: Whether NuGet clients warn about known vulnerabilities of packages from this repository, using trove's advisory data. Automatic gives the warnings while vulnerability scanning is on.
